slides.title: Kitchen finds for brains that forget food exists
Clear fridge bins
slides.body: If we can't see it, it doesn't exist. Clear bins keep food visible so it gets eaten, not forgotten.

slides.title: An 'eat first' bin
slides.body: A labeled bin at eye level for leftovers and stuff that's about to go bad. Everyone checks it first.

slides.title: Spinning turntables
slides.body: For the back of cabinets and the fridge. A spin shows you everything. No more buying your 4th jar of cumin.

slides.title: Dry erase marker on the fridge
slides.body: Write what's inside and the date it was made. You can see dinner options without opening the door.

slides.title: Clear pantry canisters
slides.body: You'll see when you're running low. No surprise 'we're out of pasta' at 7pm.

slides.title: Out of sight, out of mind. So now nothing in my kitchen is out of sight.
